recognize_zh: 玻璃體液抹片中散在比周圍小淋巴球大好幾倍的大型異型細胞，核圓、染色質細、細胞質嗜鹼性，常成小群；右上一片長形深染核排列整齊並帶纖維狀物的是脫落的視網膜細胞，左上可見黑綠色色素顆粒，勿誤認為腫瘤。
features: Scattered large atypical lymphoid cells, several times the size of small lymphocytes, singly and in small clusters
Round to slightly irregular nuclei with fine chromatin and deep basophilic cytoplasm; occasional binucleate forms
Sheet of detached retinal cells with small elongated dark nuclei aligned along pink-violet fibrillary material
Dark green-brown pigment granules consistent with retinal pigment epithelium-derived melanin
Scattered small lymphocytes, red cells, and cellular debris in background
describe_en: Vitreous fluid cytospin shows a paucicellular background with scattered red cells, small lymphocytes, and debris. There are numerous large atypical lymphoid cells, singly and in small clusters, with round to irregular nuclei, fine chromatin, and moderate deeply basophilic cytoplasm, some binucleate. Separately, a cohesive fragment of detached retinal cells with small uniform elongated dark nuclei and fibrillary material and clumps of green-brown pigment are present and should not be mistaken for tumor. Findings are suggestive of involvement by large B-cell lymphoma (vitreoretinal lymphoma), to be confirmed by flow cytometry, IL-10/IL-6 ratio, or MYD88 L265P testing given the fragility of these cells.

ddx.vs: Retinal cells are small, uniform, and cohesive with elongated dark nuclei and fibrillary outer segments, unlike the large discohesive atypical lymphoid cells.

ddx.dx: Uveitis with reactive lymphocytes and macrophages
ddx.vs: Inflammatory vitreous shows small mature lymphocytes and foamy macrophages without large atypical cells, and a low IL-10/IL-6 ratio.

ddx.dx: Metastatic carcinoma or melanoma to the vitreous
ddx.vs: Carcinoma cells form cohesive epithelial groups and melanoma cells contain intrinsic melanin and are S100/SOX10-positive, whereas lymphoma is CD20-positive and discohesive.
Macrophages have abundant vacuolated cytoplasm with phagocytosed pigment and bland reniform nuclei.
